responsibility: Provides the z/TPF operating-system configuration layer for the S/390 backend, overriding default target macros for ABI, stack pointer offset, startup and link specs, predefined macros, library naming, exception-data encoding, assembler specs, and TPF tracing constants. It is the OS-specific companion to the generic backend and linux.h, adapting GCC output to TPF runtime and toolchain conventions.
same_name_distinction: Within the tpf same-name group, this file is the OS configuration header that overrides generic S/390 macros, specs, defaults, and hardcoded trace constants for z/TPF. Unlike tpf.md it does not define RTL patterns, and unlike tpf.opt it does not declare user option syntax.
